owner_continuous_geometry.mass_rule: Do not use the envelope mass as the fluid target; the closed-bed clipping/draw order defines the fluid region and no scalar owner mass is published.

closed_bed_geometry.representation: closed analytic xz profile extruded along y
closed_bed_geometry.polygon_interpretation: The two ordered profiles bound the closed extruded bed solid. This is a geometry contract, not a measured fluid-volume result.

formal_scientific_domain.bed_set: B = piecewise-linear closed xz polygon between lower_profile_xz_m and upper_profile_xz_m, extruded for y in [-0.22,0.22]
formal_scientific_domain.candidate_fluid_set: E \ B (subject to the recorded GenCase clip/draw-order orientation)
formal_scientific_domain.why: The V3 report establishes finite generated support inside the envelope and records the closed-bed/clip operations, but it does not publish an owner scalar mass or a source-level fluid-side quadrature of E\B.

actual_discrete_diagnostic.scientific_role: Generated particle support and source-relative sample mass only; this does not establish E\B continuous mass or a matched continuous initial state.

frozen_scope_and_next_step.continuous_mass_gate: UNKNOWN until source clip orientation/quadrature and owner mass are explicitly supplied
frozen_scope_and_next_step.next_information_gain: Source-level audit of the Def clipplane/draw order and a bounded analytic piecewise-linear E\B volume calculation; only then register a material-compatible grid or an explicit continuous-owner failure scope.
